timeline.text: Welcome to Sunday Night Anxiety. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Sunday night is already turning into Monday.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep thinking about everything waiting for me.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not feel ready for the week.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind is running through tomorrow in advance.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is holding the pressure of Monday.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish the weekend did not have to end.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes I should prepare for every possibility.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel dread.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Tomorrow is taking over tonight.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let Sunday still be Sunday.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Monday does not need me yet.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can write down what matters and stop rehearsing it.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I only need to be in this evening.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can leave work mode for now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Rest is useful preparation too.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not have to solve the whole week tonight.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can create a gentler transition into tomorrow.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can give this evening back to myself.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to be off right now.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Tomorrow will arrive one moment at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to meet what is actually there.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can begin the week without living it in advance.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is ready to rest tonight.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I have done enough preparation for now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: A new week does not require a perfect start.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can carry steadiness into Monday.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: Tonight, I choose to be here.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
